That said, the six-week sustained elevation tied to consolidation justifies targeted follow-up rather than closure on routine variation.

Simultaneously propose a short-notice complementary inspection narrowly scoped to the consolidated production area or, if access constraints apply, intensified remote thermal/logistics monitoring for the next eight weeks.  
If documentation and sensor cross-checks align, treat as routine variation; if there are substantive discrepancies or refusal to cooperate, escalate to leadership for consideration of further verification actions.
